Re-author 701.10 on a black-border card: Unleash Fury (4eaa100c-f1ef-4a2b-9370-5dad7f3a95f2), ruling 2020-06-23 (doubling power gives +X/+0, X fixed as the effect begins), deciding rule 701.10b.

question: Maro's Gone Nuts doubles any effect that doubles. Does it also double a creature's double strike?

expected.shortAnswer: No: double strike is not an effect, so it is not doubled.
expected.answer: Double strike isn’t an effect, so it’s not doubled.
